name: Strongbox
summary: A 6-digit code field built as the number wheels of a safe that swings open
about: Each digit rolls a number wheel inside a steel safe door, like a real combination lock. With the right code the handle spins, the brass bolts slide back and the door swings open to show what is inside. Good for two-step login, payment checks and any page where people enter an authenticator code.
how: Type or paste the 6-digit demo code; each wheel rolls to its number
Use Left and Right arrows to move, Up and Down arrows or the scroll wheel to roll a wheel
The code is checked when the last wheel is set, or when you press Enter or turn the handle
A right code turns the light green, spins the handle, pulls the bolts and opens the door
A wrong code blinks the light red and rolls every wheel back to blank
